mapper.select: SELECT md.membership_id, md.department_id, CAST(d.path AS text) AS path, md.is_primary AS "primary" FROM membership_department md JOIN department d ON d.tenant_id = md.tenant_id AND d.id = md.department_id WHERE md.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT d.deleted AND md.membership_id IN #{id, javaType=java.lang.Object} ORDER BY md.membership_id, md.is_primary DESC, d.path

SELECT mp.membership_id, mp.position_id FROM membership_position mp JOIN position p ON p.tenant_id = mp.tenant_id AND p.id = mp.position_id WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT p.deleted AND mp.membership_id IN #{id, javaType=java.lang.Object} ORDER BY mp.membership_id, p.name

SELECT DISTINCT md.membership_id FROM membership_department md JOIN department d ON d.tenant_id = md.tenant_id AND d.id = md.department_id WHERE md.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.path <@ CAST(#{path} AS ltree) AND NOT d.deleted
SELECT count(*) FROM membership_department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND department_id = #{departmentId}
SELECT count(*) FROM membership_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND position_id = #{positionId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM membership_department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership_id = #{membershipId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_department (membership_id, tenant_id, department_id, is_primary) VALUES (#{membershipId}, #{tenantId}, #{departmentId}, #{primary})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM membership_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership_id = #{membershipId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_position (membership_id, tenant_id, position_id) VALUES (#{membershipId}, #{tenantId}, #{positionId})
